errors.evidence: The chart contains seven bars per group, not six as stated.

errors.text_span: Стълбовете са подредени по азбучен ред според легендата
errors.evidence: The bars are not arranged alphabetically according to the legend; they follow the order in the legend: Spain, France, China, Italy, Turkey, USA, Argentina.
The description does not explicitly state that the chart represents vineyard areas in thousands of hectares for different countries over the period 2013–2022.
The description does not mention that Spain consistently has the highest values (around 950 thousand hectares) and Argentina the lowest (around 200 thousand hectares), with no changes over the years.
The description does not mention the linear scale of the vertical axis.

errors.text_span: Хоризонталната ос представлява годините, разположени в азбучен ред отляво надясно
errors.evidence: The years on the horizontal axis are arranged in ascending chronological order, not alphabetical order.
